Q3 revenue likely to finish below the $48M target, with a 78% chance of missing
⚠️ High-severity insight
  • Based on current pipeline conditions and the outcomes of comparable opportunities, Q3 revenue is projected to finish between $41.2M and $45.8M, below the $48M target. The analysis found a 78% likelihood of missing the target under current conditions.
  • Three opportunities represent 37% of the remaining Commit forecast.
  • Late-stage deals without recent executive engagement are converting at less than half the rate of comparable deals with active executive involvement. The pattern remains after accounting for region, industry, deal size, and sales segment.
  • Close dates are moving later while the time needed to complete procurement, legal, and security reviews remains unchanged.
Recommended actions
  • Run an exec-sponsor sweep on late-stage deals. Pair each one without recent exec engagement with a sponsor and book an exec-to-exec call this week.
  • Hold deal-by-deal reviews on the 3 opportunities making up 37% of remaining Commit. Confirm the economic buyer, open blockers, and close plan, and decide which to swap out of Commit if they can’t be de-risked.
  • Start procurement, legal, and security reviews earlier. Launch them in parallel at the proposal stage and run a weekly fast-lane triage on open deals.
  • Build a gap-closing plan for the $2.2M–$6.8M shortfall. Identify pull-in candidates and quick wins such as upsell, edition upgrades, and cross-sell.
